gaps.sentence: Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.

gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
Put ___ your coat — it's freezing outside.
gaps.explanation: put on = dress in; put off = postpone.

gaps.sentence: The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.

gaps.sentence: Feel free to drop ___ for a coffee any time.
gaps.explanation: drop in = pay a casual visit; drop off = fall asleep or deliver.

gaps.sentence: They're ___ up a new office in the old warehouse district.
Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: Please fill ___ this form and sign at the bottom.
gaps.explanation: fill in/out a form (British prefers in).
